page_objective: Define SIPANEL's core messaging structure, value proposition, communication hierarchy, and reusable message pillars across brand, website, sales, SEO, and technical content.

messaging_foundation.core_message: SIPANEL reduces industrial panel project risk through precise design, smart procurement, and engineered installation.
messaging_foundation.brand_philosophy: We Engineer. We Control. We Deliver.
messaging_foundation.brand_message: PRECISE DESIGN | SMART PROCUREMENT | ENGINEERED INSTALLATION

positioning_statement.statement: SIPANEL is an engineering-first industrial panel systems partner that controls design, procurement, and installation to reduce leakage risk, material waste, delays, hidden costs, and execution mistakes.
positioning_statement.short_version: Engineering-controlled sandwich panel systems for industrial projects.

primary_value_proposition.headline: Reduce Project Risk Before Construction Begins.
primary_value_proposition.supporting_message: Precision shop drawings, controlled procurement, and engineered installation systems for industrial panel projects.
primary_value_proposition.conversion_message: Start your project with engineering clarity before material is purchased or installed.

level_1_main_hero_message.message: Reduce Sandwich Panel Project Risk Before Execution Starts

level_2_supporting_message.message: SIPANEL engineers, optimizes, and verifies your industrial panel project before installation — reducing leakage risk, material waste, delays, and hidden costs.

level_3_proof_message.message: Shop drawing based planning, drainage and waterproofing logic, material takeoff optimization, and installation quality checkpoints.

level_4_conversion_message.message: Get a free engineering review before your project enters execution.

message_pillars.core_idea: Technical planning before execution reduces mistakes and uncertainty.
message_pillars.proof_direction: Use shop drawing previews, technical annotations, and layout examples.

message_pillars.core_idea: Correct material decisions reduce waste, hidden cost, and project delays.
message_pillars.proof_direction: Use BOM samples, procurement workflows, and measurable optimization data.

message_pillars.core_idea: Controlled installation improves waterproofing, alignment, and long-term performance.
message_pillars.proof_direction: Use project photos, installation sequences, quality checkpoints, and case studies.

problem_solution_framework.problem_message: Most sandwich panel project failures come from fragmented execution, weak planning, poor waterproofing logic, and unclear responsibility.
problem_solution_framework.solution_message: SIPANEL coordinates engineering, procurement, and installation as one controlled system.
problem_solution_framework.result_message: The project becomes more predictable, technically clear, and less exposed to leakage, waste, rework, and delay.

primary_risks.message: Drainage, flashing, overlap, and sealing details are planned before installation.
Optimized panel layout and accurate material takeoff reduce unnecessary purchasing.
Engineering coordination before procurement reduces site conflicts and rework.
Panel type, core, thickness, and skin material are selected based on project conditions.
Technical review helps identify problems before they become expensive execution issues.

industrial_project_owners.message: Reduce project uncertainty with engineering-controlled design, procurement, and installation.

contractors.message: Install with approved drawings, clear sequencing, and controlled waterproofing details.

consulting_engineers.message: Review shop drawings, drainage logic, and technical details before execution begins.

procurement_teams.message: Reduce waste and wrong purchasing through accurate BOM / MTO and supplier coordination.

homepage: Reduce Project Risk Before Construction Begins.
Engineering-controlled sandwich panel systems for industrial projects.
Plan drainage, waterproofing, material takeoff, and installation before execution starts.
service_pages: Professional shop drawings for panel layout, cutting optimization, slope design, and material takeoff.
Controlled installation based on approved drawings, sealing principles, and quality checkpoints.
case_studies: Engineering coordination reduced installation conflicts and improved execution accuracy.
Drainage and waterproofing planning helped prevent leakage risk after installation.

rules: Do not position SIPANEL as sandwich-panel-only company.
Homepage messaging must represent all major service categories.
Engineering messaging should include roofing, cladding, and facade systems.
Use industrial building envelope terminology when appropriate.

messages_to_avoid: We are the best sandwich panel company.
Buy now before it is too late.
proof_alignment_rules: Every major message should connect to a visual, metric, case study, or technical explanation.
Risk-reduction claims must be supported by engineering logic.
Do not use unverified performance numbers.
Prefer project evidence over generic brand claims.
Use technical proof before emotional persuasion.

content_usage_mapping.trust_bar: Use verified experience, project count, and executed area metrics only.
content_usage_mapping.proof_snapshot: Use technical proof messages: shop drawings, waterproofing logic, BOM / MTO.
content_usage_mapping.projects: Use challenge, engineering decision, result, and risk prevented.
content_usage_mapping.cta_sections: Use engineering review and project confidence messaging.
content_usage_mapping.footer: Use brand slogan and concise company positioning.

rules: Do not generate abstract marketing slogans for trust bars.
Trust bars must contain measurable industrial proof.
Prefer technical credibility over branding slogans.
Avoid literal translation of technical claims without review.
Maintain the same messaging hierarchy across all languages.
Support RTL layout for Persian and Arabic.

implementation_notes: Use the messaging framework as the source of truth for website copy, sales materials, SEO pages, and technical content.
Messages must remain engineering-first, proof-based, and free from exaggerated marketing claims.
All future campaigns should map back to at least one message pillar.
